func copy_rows(input, rounds) { mut state := input
mut r := 0
while r < rounds { mut i := 0
while i < 128 { state[1][i] = state[0][i]
i += 1 }
r += 1 }
return state }
let original := [range(0, 128), range(128, 256)]
let result := copy_rows(original, 2)
assert_equal(original[1][0], 128)
assert_equal(original[1][-1], 255)
assert_equal(result[0], original[0])
assert_equal(result[1], original[0])
print("ROW ACCESS PASS")

verification_sources.refresh:
# Repository-maintenance diagnostic: pin unchanged port/config, inject only argv.
# Counts execution-time requested allocation traffic, not retained memory or speed.
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'fileutils'
require 'open3'
abort 'Expected BASELINE_PROBE CANDIDATE_PROBE CANDIDATE_BINARY NEW_OUTPUT_DIR' unless ARGV.size == 4
baseline, candidate, binary, output = ARGV.map { |p| File.expand_path(p) }
raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(output)
[baseline, candidate, binary].each { |p| raise 'Missing executable ' + p unless File.executable?(p) }
port_path = File.expand_path('benchmarks/langarena/port.kujo')
config_path = File.expand_path('benchmarks/langarena/test.json')
port = File.read(port_path)
config = JSON.parse(File.read(config_path))
names = %w[Sort::Quick Sort::Merge Etc::NeuralNet Etc::CacheSimulation Etc::GameOfLife Etc::TextRaytracer Brainfuck::Array Brainfuck::Recursion]
raise 'Argument injection boundary changed' unless port.scan('let arguments := args()').size == 1
raise 'Missing/duplicate priority cases' unless names.all? { |n| config.count { |c| c['name'] == n } == 1 }
FileUtils.mkdir_p(output)
r = { status: 'running', pid: Process.pid, scope: 'Eight unchanged priority test-size workloads; argv injection only; execution allocations include setup/warmup/checksum',
      runner_sha256: Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest,
      identities: [baseline, candidate, binary, port_path, config_path].to_h { |p| [p, Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest] },
      rows: [], semantics: [], fixtures: [] }
save = -> { File.write(output + '/report.json', JSON.pretty_generate(r) + "\n") }
save.call
begin
  names.each_with_index do |name, index|
    configuration = config.find { |c| c['name'] == name }
    source = port.sub('let arguments := args()', 'let arguments := ' + JSON.generate([config_path, name, '--profile']))
    path = output + '/' + name.gsub('::', '-') + '.kujo'
    File.write(path, source)
    metadata = { name: name, configuration: configuration, path: path, source_sha256: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(source) }
    r[:fixtures] << metadata
    expected = name + ': OK ' + configuration.fetch('checksum').to_s
    %w[vm jit].each_with_index do |mode, mode_index|
      row = metadata.merge(mode: mode)
      # Alternate revision order; no timing acceptance is derived from this run.
      order = (index + mode_index).even? ? %i[baseline candidate] : %i[candidate baseline]
      row[:order] = order
      order.each do |label|
        executable = label == :baseline ? baseline : candidate
        out, err, status = Open3.capture3(executable, mode, path)
        File.write(output + "/#{name.gsub('::', '-')}-#{mode}-#{label}.stdout", out)
        File.write(output + "/#{name.gsub('::', '-')}-#{mode}-#{label}.stderr", err)
        raise "Checksum/execution failure #{name} #{mode} #{label}: #{out}#{err}" unless status.success? && out.lines.map(&:strip).include?(expected) && out.include?('Summary: 1, 1, 0')
        counts = err.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
        raise 'Missing allocation observation' unless counts
        row[label] = { requests: counts[1].to_i, bytes: counts[2].to_i, exit: status.exitstatus, stdout: out, stderr: err }
      end
      r[:rows] << row
      save.call
    end
    out, err, status = Open3.capture3(binary, 'run', path, '--interpreter', '--scheduler-no-timeout')
    raise "Interpreter checksum failure #{name}: #{out}#{err}" unless status.success? && out.lines.map(&:strip).include?(expected) && out.include?('Summary: 1, 1, 0')
    r[:semantics] << metadata.merge(mode: 'interpreter', exit: status.exitstatus, stdout: out, stderr: err)
    save.call
  end
  raise 'Allocation coverage' unless r[:rows].map { |x| x.values_at(:name, :mode) }.sort == names.product(%w[vm jit]).sort
  raise 'Interpreter coverage' unless r[:semantics].map { |x| x[:name] } == names
  r[:identities].each { |p, h| raise 'Artifact/source drift ' + p unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest == h }
  r[:fixtures].each { |f| raise 'Fixture drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(f[:path]).hexdigest == f[:source_sha256] }
  r[:status] = 'characterized'
  save.call
rescue => e
  r[:status] = 'failed'
  r[:error] = e.message
  save.call
  raise
end

require 'json';require 'open3';require 'digest'
d=File.expand_path(__dir__);s={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,stage:'wait-refresh',rows:[]};save=->{File.write(d+'/repeatability.json',JSON.pretty_generate(s)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 r=nil
 loop do
  r=JSON.parse(File.read(d+'/report.json'));break if r['status']=='characterized';raise r['error'] if r['status']=='failed';Process.kill(0,r.fetch('pid'));sleep 2
 end
 target=r.fetch('rows').find{|x|x['name']=='Sort::Quick'&&x['mode']=='jit'} or raise 'Missing case'
 binaries={baseline:File.expand_path('../row-overflow-v2-2026-10-28/task-allocation-probe',d),candidate:File.expand_path('../compact-binding-map-v1-2026-10-28/task-allocation-probe',d)}
 s[:stage]='repeat-quicksort-jit';s[:fixture_sha256]=Digest::SHA256.file(target['path']).hexdigest;s[:identities]=binaries.transform_values{|p|Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest};save.call
 3.times do |round|
  order=round.even? ? %i[candidate baseline] : %i[baseline candidate]
  order.each do |label|
   out,err,status=Open3.capture3(binaries.fetch(label),'jit',target['path'])
   raise out+err unless status.success?&&out.lines.map(&:strip).include?('Sort::Quick: OK '+target['configuration']['checksum'].to_s)&&out.include?('Summary: 1, 1, 0')
   m=err.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise err unless m
   s[:rows]<<{round:round,label:label,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i,stdout:out,stderr:err};save.call
  end
 end
 raise 'Fixture drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(target['path']).hexdigest==s[:fixture_sha256]
 s[:status]='characterized';s[:stage]='complete';save.call
rescue=>e;s[:status]='failed';s[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3'
d=File.expand_path(__dir__);root=File.expand_path('../compact-binding-map-v1-2026-10-28',d);probe=root+'/task-allocation-probe';binary=root+'/candidate-kujo'
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,scope:'Diagnostic nested-row versus extracted-row copy loops; not a benchmark rewrite or optimization acceptance',runner_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest,identities:[probe,binary].to_h{|p|[p,Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest]},rows:[],semantics:[],sources:{}}
save=->{File.write(d+'/report.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 [128,2048].product([2,4],%w[nested extracted]).each do |width,rounds,form|
  init=form=='nested' ? 'mut state := input' : 'let src := input[0] mut dst := input[1]'
  body=form=='nested' ? 'state[1][i] = state[0][i]' : 'dst[i] = src[i]'
  result=form=='nested' ? 'state' : '[src, dst]'
  source="func copy_rows(input, rounds) { #{init}\nmut r := 0\nwhile r < rounds { mut i := 0\nwhile i < #{width} { #{body}\ni += 1 }\nr += 1 }\nreturn #{result} }\nlet original := [range(0, #{width}), range(#{width}, #{2*width})]\nlet result := copy_rows(original, #{rounds})\nassert_equal(original[1][0], #{width})\nassert_equal(original[1][-1], #{2*width-1})\nassert_equal(result[0], original[0])\nassert_equal(result[1], original[0])\nprint(\"ROW ACCESS PASS\")\n"
  path=d+"/#{form}-#{width}-#{rounds}.kujo";File.write(path,source);hash=Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(source);r[:sources][hash]=source
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   out,err,status=Open3.capture3(probe,mode,path);raise out+err unless status.success?&&out=="ROW ACCESS PASS\n"
   m=err.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise err unless m
   r[:rows]<<{form:form,width:width,rounds:rounds,mode:mode,source_sha256:hash,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i};save.call
  end
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   args=[binary,'run',path,'--untrusted'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm'
   out,err,status=Open3.capture3(*args);raise out+err unless status.success?&&out=="ROW ACCESS PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<{form:form,width:width,rounds:rounds,mode:mode,source_sha256:hash,exit:status.exitstatus};save.call
  end
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==16&&r[:semantics].size==24
 r[:deltas]=r[:rows].group_by{|x|x.values_at(:form,:width,:mode)}.map{|key,rows|a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x[:rounds]};{form:key[0],width:key[1],mode:key[2],requests_per_write:(b[:requests]-a[:requests])/(2.0*key[1]),bytes_per_write:(b[:bytes]-a[:bytes])/(2.0*key[1])}}
 r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'Artifact drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 r[:status]='characterized';save.call
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

limitations: Requested allocation traffic includes execution setup/warmup/checksum; not retained memory or loop-only cost
QuickSort repetition does not classify differences in other cases
Nested/extracted fixtures diagnose representation cost; unchanged benchmark port is not rewritten
JIT micro deltas vary with compilation; VM two-allocation/320-byte penalty is the specific reproduced target
